articles.title: Judge who awarded 36 death sentences in 16 months transferred to family court
articles.summary: Judge Ravi Kumar Diwakar has been transferred to the family court after awarding multiple death sentences. He gained national attention for his decisions in Muzaffarnagar, including a notable case of a husband burning his wife.

articles.title: KL Rahul's horror show: Duck followed by bizarre hit-wicket dismissal
articles.summary: KL Rahul struggled in the first unofficial Test against New Zealand A, scoring only four runs in two innings. In the first innings, he was dismissed for a duck after edging a catch to the wicketkeeper.

Quake Hits Vanuatu: 6.2 tremor strikes at 125 km depth; no damage reports yet
articles.summary: On October 25, the Vanuatu islands experienced a magnitude 6.2 earthquake, originating at a depth of 125 kilometers. This region, known for its seismic volatility and volcanic activity, felt the quake's impact; however, its depth typically minimizes surface shaking.

articles.summary: ISRO has declared the 2026 recruitment result for Assistant, Junior Personal Assistant, Upper Division Clerk and Stenographer posts on October 24. Candidates who appeared for the computer-based test on September 21 can check their roll numbers in the merit list PDF at isro.gov.in.

articles.title: TS SSC Time Table 2027: Telangana Class 10 date sheet expected in December, fee payment begins October 30
articles.summary: The Telangana Board is expected to release the TS SSC Time Table 2027 for Class 10 students in December 2026. The SSC Public Examinations are scheduled for March 2027, while examination fee payment without a late charge will be open from October 30 to November 16, 2026.

articles.title: CBSE date sheet 2027 for Classes 10 and 12 expected soon at cbse.gov.in: Check steps to download and other key details here
articles.summary: The CBSE date sheet 2027 for Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations is expected to be released soon on the official website, cbse.gov.in. The examinations are likely to begin in February 2027, though the board has not confirmed the schedule.

articles.title: Jamia Millia Islamia moves classes online amid row over student protests, safety concerns
articles.summary: Jamia Millia Islamia announced the transition to online classes to ensure student safety amid ongoing protests. The protests began after five students initiated an indefinite hunger strike on October 12.

articles.title: Salman Khan launches high-rise luxury residential project in Punjab
articles.summary: Salman Khan has announced a luxury residential project in Punjab amidst security threats. He could not attend the launch event but sent a supportive video message.

articles.title: Sudev Nair says Mammootty's ‘Bheeshma Parvam’ made him popular
articles.summary: Sudev Nair attributes his increased recognition in the Malayalam film industry to his role in Amal Neerad's Bheeshma Parvam. He revealed that audiences continue to identify him as Rajan Mon wherever he appears.

articles.title: Daler Mehndi’s son Gurdeep thanks Mika Singh amid Uttarakhand performance controversy
articles.summary: Gurdeep Mehndi expresses heartfelt gratitude to Mika Singh and fellow celebrities for their unwavering support for Daler Mehndi amid the ongoing controversy. Upon returning from abroad, Gurdeep reassured himself of his father's well-being.

articles.title: SS Rajamouli used ‘Baahubali’ logo to promote ‘RRR’ in Hindi markets
articles.summary: SS Rajamouli's 'RRR' has captured hearts globally, becoming a remarkable phenomenon. Varun Gupta from the marketing team faced unique challenges in reaching Hindi-speaking audiences.
